credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: View of five  pack mules or horses, with gear on their backs, grazing in a field of grasses with pine trees and mountain peaks with patches of snow in the background.   This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Lyell Fork
